name: Jellyfin All-In-One
description: Builds smart collections by franchise, studio, title, series, genre and YouTube channel, and fetches YouTube titles, channels, descriptions and thumbnails without an API key.
overview: Smart collections + YouTube metadata in one plugin

versions.changelog: Smart grouping replaces broad All Movies/All TV Shows lists. Adds franchise/trilogy detection, YouTube channel grouping and channel-to-studio metadata.
